# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue or discussion for a security vulnerability.

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
on the affected repository when it is enabled. Otherwise contact an organization
owner of [Lipford-Dutch](https://github.com/Lipford-Dutch) through GitHub
and include a description, impact, and steps to reproduce.

You should hear back from a maintainer. We will confirm the report, discuss a
fix, and credit you if you want to be named.

## Scope

This policy covers software and documentation published by the Lipford-Dutch
organization. Third-party forks and upstream projects should be reported to
their own maintainers.
